title: The Lively & Liveable Neighbourhoods that are Illegal in Most of North America
summary: Not Just Bikes explains how small pockets of shops and restaurants inside residential Dutch neighbourhoods create liveliness and help reduce traffic. It argues this kind of mixed-use design has been illegal in most of the US and Canada for a century because of zoning, and should be brought back.
why: HN commenters link it in zoning, housing and car-dependency threads as an accessible explanation of how single-use zoning and parking rules shape cities.

quote.text: Not Just Bikes talks about zoning in the US vs Dutch cities in this video
